name: Bitter-eggplant salad
summary: A salad of bitter eggplant and dried fish, one of the older highland plates that stays on restaurant menus in the province.
seoTitle: Goi ca dang — bitter eggplant and dried fish
seoDescription: Bitter-eggplant and dried-fish salad on Dak Nong restaurant menus, according to Bao Lam Dong.
